sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Military Academy Degrees and Certificates Ordinance 1959
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE PAKISTAN MILITARY ACADEMY
THE PAKISTAN
MILITARY ACADEMY
(DEGREES AND
CERTIFICATES) ORDINANCE, 1959
ORDINANCE No. LI of 1959
[16th September,
1959]
An Ordinance to authorise the Pakistan Military Academy at
Kakul to confer degrees and grant certificates.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Military Academy (Degrees and
Certificates) Ordinance, 1959.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Military Academy Degrees and Certificates Ordinance 1959
sections.description:
Definition

THE PAKISTAN MILITARY ACADEMY
THE PAKISTAN
MILITARY ACADEMY
(DEGREES AND
CERTIFICATES) ORDINANCE, 1959
ORDINANCE No. LI of 1959
[16th September,
1959]
An Ordinance to authorise the Pakistan Military Academy at
Kakul to confer degrees and grant certificates.
2. Definition.---In this
Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
(a)
"Academy" means the Pakistan Military Academy at Kakul;
(b)
"certificate" means a certificate mentioned in Part II of the
Schedule; and
(c)
"degree" means a degree mentioned in Part I of the Schedule.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Military Academy Degrees and Certificates Ordinance 1959
sections.description:
Conferment of degrees, etc., on cadets and officers

THE PAKISTAN MILITARY ACADEMY
THE PAKISTAN
MILITARY ACADEMY
(DEGREES AND
CERTIFICATES) ORDINANCE, 1959
ORDINANCE No. LI of 1959
[16th September,
1959]
An Ordinance to authorise the Pakistan Military Academy at
Kakul to confer degrees and grant certificates.
*[3. Conferment of degrees,
etc., on cadets and officers.---(1)] The Academy shall have the power
to confer a degree on, or grant a certificate to, any gentleman cadet of the
Academy on his successful completion of the appropriate course at the Academy,
and such power shall include the power to confer a degree on, or grant a
certificate to, any officer who at any time before the commencement of this
Ordinance was commissioned from the Academy.
**[(2) The
provisions of sub-section (1) shall apply to those gentlemen cadets of the
Academy who, before the commence ment of the Pakistan Military Academy (Degrees
and Certi ficates) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1962, had successfully com pleted
their training at the Royal Military Academy, Sandhurst, or who after such
commencement, successfully complete their training at that Academy.]
*[Section 3 was re-numbered as sub-section
(1) of that section by the Pakistan Military Academy (Degrees and Certificates)
(Amdt.) Ordinance, 1962 (19 of 1962), s. 2.]
**[Sub-section (2) added ibid.]
